pipeline_detail_not_found: That deal does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
pipeline_list_filtered_note: These numbers describe the filtered pipeline.
pipeline_board_meta: Open stages only. Drag a card to change its stage
pipeline_move_failed_reverted: Could not move the deal; reverted.
pipeline_move_failed_reverted_network: Could not move the deal, reverted.
pipeline_board_truncated: Showing the first {count}. Filter to see the rest.
pipeline_empty_body_leads: Nothing matches this view. Start a deal from an account you are already talking to, convert a lead that is ready, or clear a filter to see more.
pipeline_empty_body: Nothing matches this view. Start a deal from an account you are already talking to, or clear a filter to see more.
pipeline_new_sub: Five fields to start. Everything else can wait until you know it.
pipeline_error_name: Give the deal a name you would recognise in a list.
pipeline_error_account_pick: Pick the account this deal belongs to.
pipeline_error_amount_positive: Amount has to be a number greater than zero.
pipeline_error_close_missing: When do you expect this to close?
pipeline_error_close_past: That date has passed. Pick the date you now expect.
pipeline_error_probability: Probability is a percentage between 0 and 100.
pipeline_form_marked_below: They are marked below. Nothing has been saved.
pipeline_field_name_hint: What you would say out loud, “40 seats plus onboarding”, not “Opportunity 118”.
pipeline_new_stage_hint: A new deal cannot start closed. Won and lost are things you do to a deal that exists, so they are not offered here.
pipeline_new_owner_hint: Defaults to you. Who created the deal is recorded separately and is not editable.
pipeline_error_account_required: A deal has to belong to an account.
pipeline_error_won_amount: A won deal has to record what it was worth.
pipeline_error_amount_number: Amount has to be a number.
pipeline_error_closed_stage_needs_date: A closed stage needs the date it closed.
pipeline_edit_clock_before: The stage clock restarts. This deal currently reads
pipeline_edit_clock_after: on the board; after saving it reads 0 days and On pace, because aging is measured from the last stage change and not from the last time anyone did anything.
pipeline_edit_line_items_total: add up to {total}. The server refuses a different figure on a deal with line items, so this cannot be typed over. Edit the line items instead.
pipeline_edit_amount_manual_hint: Typed by hand. Adding line items to this deal would take the field over.
pipeline_edit_closed_on_hint: The date it actually closed, not the date you are recording it.
pipeline_detail_delete_explain: Deletes {name} permanently. This cannot be undone.
pipeline_detail_no_people: Nobody is linked to this deal yet. Add the person who signs it.
pipeline_detail_invoice_failed: Could not raise an invoice from this deal.
pipeline_detail_interactions_failed: Calls and messages could not be loaded, so they are missing below.
